label: PF Backlog 80
title: BUG: run_discovery synthesis writes near-empty domain-analysis/stakeholder-map/user-personas despite answered panel
body: Observed: after the 360 panel was fully answered (57/57), run_discovery() wrote docs/domain-analysis.md (22 B), docs/stakeholder-map.md (22 B), docs/user-personas.md (20 B) - i.e. only the section header, no content. The synthesis functions bucket by agent ('business_analyst'/'product_analyst'/'ux_researcher'), but discovery_panel.to_discovery_answers() stamps answers with the PANEL agent id (e.g. 'product-analyzer', 'architect', 'ux-ia'), so the buckets are empty and sections come out blank. Fix: map panel agent -> synthesis perspective (product_clarity/domain_business/user_experience) when building DiscoveryAnswer.agent, or change the synthesizers to bucket on the panel perspectives. Refs: core/discovery_engine.py synthesize_domain_analysis/stakeholder_map/user_personas; core/discovery_panel.py to_discovery_answers.
